card.name: Start of tetrahydro- chemical names
card.fires_on: The first pieces of the word tetrahydrocannabinol or tetrahydrobiopterin ("tet", "ra"), mostly in THC urine-test warnings. Also seen on a few other word starts such as "hem" in hemoglobin.

modes.label: tetrahydro- names
modes.description: The opening pieces "tet" or "ra" of tetrahydrocannabinol or tetrahydrobiopterin.
modes.example: There have been reports of false positive urine screening tests for<< tet>>rahydrocannabinol (THC

modes.label: Other word starts
modes.description: A scattered start of another medical term, such as hem in hemoglobin or "to" before thienopyridines.
modes.example: When old red blood cells die,<< hem>>oglobin is released into the blood stream.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens look unrelated to the text pattern.
card.plain: It lights up when a long chemical name like tetrahydrocannabinol is just beginning.
